text: The list of applicants and the relevant details of the applications are set out in the appended table.
The applicants complained of disproportionate measures taken against them as participants of a public assembly.
The public assembly in which the applicants participated consisted of manifestations for fair elections to the Moscow City Parliament.
The manifestations for fair elections to the Moscow City Parliament took place in August 2019 in Moscow.
The applicants raised other complaints under the provisions of the Convention in addition to their complaint about disproportionate measures.
